status: descriptive mechanism census; not a confirmatory test
purpose: Quantify the round-1 black and gray sets, their true/false composition, the overlap between the +2 gray band and the baseline black set, and the positions re-admitted by the gray step.
keys: G0 pool keys 54..99 (46 keys), 2000 errors each, same seed discipline as decoder_transfer

definitions.tau0: classic binomial threshold at the initial syndrome, clipped to [(d+1)/2, d]
definitions.recheck: after the black step, flip back black positions whose post-black UPC >= (d+1)/2 + 1
definitions.gray_readmit: after the black and recheck steps, flip gray positions whose current UPC >= (d+1)/2 + 1
definitions.effective: positions flipped in round one after black, recheck and gray, counted with parity (a position flipped twice is not in the effective set)

disclosure: The true error support is used only for offline diagnostics; it is not a deployable statistic. Counts are descriptive; no formal test is attached to this census.
outputs: per-instance arrays in npz, aggregate means in JSON, Chinese report
